boundaries: 4 unique requests per cell, 16 measured request executions; no general quality or method novelty claim.
Full per-token route ids/weights were not retained; comparisons identify physical rows and required expert unions/groups only.
Unique entry lower bound = current call required union minus reconstructed entry residents, times actual expert weight size.
Extra traffic includes reload of an entry resident evicted before use, as well as repeated loaded-list appearances.
All reduction/map/recording costs are inside observed wall. Shared batch expert bytes cannot be charged separately to prefill and decode rows.
Both repeats are retained; observed expert runtime variation is reported without attributing unmeasured causes.
Cross-policy physical rows match but 34/160 required expert unions differ; this is independently executed policy state, not a fixed-route copy-only counterfactual.
Later two requests have worse maxITL under expert execution in both repeats despite lower TTFT/completion; do not claim every latency metric improves.
Rows are split by native prefill/decode counts: first three steps contain (64,0), (127,1), (65,2); bytes remain shared per engine call.
Actual initial GPU map tensor was not separately dumped; complete recorded slot-to-expert and LRU arrays/clock are compared without dropping absolute ticks.
